title: Demo v1
description: Body of GET /demo on the app backend (P4.6a): whether the profile has the cluster panel's demo buttons, the replay patterns Start offers, and what the host's demo runner (make demo-runner) reports. The runner's own GET /status is the runner object below.

enabled.description: The profile's app.demo_controls.enabled. When false the UI shows no buttons and nothing else is filled in.

poll_seconds.description: How long the UI waits before asking again: the profile's Prometheus scrape interval, as cluster.v1's.

patterns.description: app.demo_controls.patterns in the profile's order, each with the runs its replay.patterns entry starts, which Start's label names.

runner.description: The runner's GET /status; null when it did not answer, and runner_error says why.

runner_error.description: One sentence for the UI's caption when runner is null and enabled is true; null otherwise.

replay.description: The runner's latest replay since it started; null before the first.

last_kill.description: The runner's latest pod kill since it started; null before the first.

command.description: The command the runner ran, as a person would type it.

state.description: running until the command exits; then done when the replay wrote its output, which it does after its last run even with calls lost (make exits 2 then, as for a crash), failed when it ended without it.

runs_finished.description: Runs the replay has written, finished or failed.

calls_failed.description: Calls among them with no full reply after any retry (trace.v1 lines without duration_ms).

exit_code.description: The command's exit code; null while it runs.

utc.description: UTC to the second, ISO 8601, as the runner writes it. A pattern, since jsonschema checks no format unless asked.
